name: Crimson Spriggan
description: A titan clad in black iron and molten gold, born from the Spriggan bloodline. Crimson Spriggan rises from the brink of destruction — shedding its outer armor to reveal an indestructible core that burns hotter the more it suffers.

ability.name: Iron Rebirth
ability.description: When HP drops below 35%, Crimson Spriggan sheds its outer armor layer — instantly nullifying all incoming damage for 2 turns, healing 35 HP, and permanently increasing Defense by 30. Additionally, its Special Move gains +50 bonus damage for the rest of the battle.

chain._note: Iron Rebirth: nullify all damage for 2 turns on activation
Iron Rebirth: heal 35 HP on activation (35/700 ≈ 0.05)
Iron Rebirth: +30 Defense permanently after armor shed
Iron Rebirth: +50 Special Move damage permanently after armor shed

special_move.name: Golden Star Judgement
special_move.description: Revive Phoenix channels all its molten fury into its golden star core — launching three crushing armor-shattering blows that grow stronger the more damage it has endured!
